title: Fleet Orbit: Scaling Ledger & Throughput Compass for Dedicated Capacity
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a new Console experience that combines precise scaling controls, an operator-grade throughput dashboard, and an immutable change ledger for Dedicated capacity fleets. The feature (aka Fleet Orbit) should let operators: 1) set and preview autoscaling policies (target utilization, min/max pools, scheduled windows, buffer headroom), 2) perform manual overrides with timeboxed expirations and safety fences, and 3) inspect a time-series throughput & latency canvas with per-model commit overlays and rollout annotations. The change ledger must show who changed which scaling knob, diff previous/next policy, and provide rollback links to prior configurations. Primary goals: reduce operator mean-time-to-recover from capacity issues, make cost trade-offs explicit, and surface regressions introduced by scaling policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI exposes controls for policy creation: target_qps/target_utilization, min_replicas, max_replicas, scale_cooldown, and schedule windows
Operators can apply a manual override with an expiration and optional reason that appears in the ledger
Throughput dashboard includes selectable time range, per-fleet P50/P95/P99 latency overlays, effective concurrency and token throughput, and a model commit overlay (commit id + short message)
Change ledger is append-only, records user, timestamp, before/after JSON diff, and links to the API call and associated PR or runbook
A rollback action re-applies a previous policy and emits a ledger entry documenting the rollforward/rollback
Telemetry emitted for UI interactions (policy_create, policy_update, manual_override, rollback) and validated in staging dashboards
End-to-end tests cover policy CRUD, manual override expiry, rollback, and permission gating (operator vs viewer roles)
Feature flag gate to allow progressive enablement per-org and a console-2026.04 release bundle entry
tasks: Design: final mockups for policy editor, manual override modal, and ledger diff view
Backend: policy model schema, validation, audit trail storage, and policy evaluation hook in autoscaler service
Frontend: React components for policy editor, throughput canvas using timeseries library, and ledger timeline UI
API: create/update/list/get/rollback endpoints; OpenAPI docs and SDK surface notes
QA: test matrix for schedule windows, timezone edge cases, and concurrency race on concurrent updates
Telemetry: event definitions and staging Grafana dashboard for QA validation
Docs: Confluence runbook, user guide for operators, and changelog entry
